roots.label: Technical Element
roots.description: The complete, ever-expanding forest of technical elements: every decomposition table of the technica corpus merged into one instance tree.

children.label: JobRunr
children.description: Embeddable background-processing library instance plus its server, storage, dashboard, and practices.

children.label: Coherence (one persisted job, many realizations)
children.description: Organizing structure: a single persisted (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Architecture record drives scheduling, claiming, execution, retry, and observation.

children.label: JobRequest pattern
children.description: Command/handler separation: (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Architecture carries data, JobRequestHandler performs the work.

children.label: JobRequest
children.description: Interface carrying job data plus getJobRequestHandler().

children.label: BackgroundJobRequest
children.description: Static facade offering the same API for JobRequests.

children.label: Realized capability
children.description: Capability realized: durable, distributed background work on the JVM with no extra infrastructure.

children.label: Governance (author + licenses)
children.description: Ronald Dehuysser authorship; (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Institution on GitHub; LGPL 3.0 OSS plus commercial Pro tier.

children.label: Distribution (Maven Central)
children.description: Versioned artifact (root) > Technical Element Set > Production Technical System > Production Technical Object > Constitutive Technical Object consumed via Maven or Gradle (exemplar 8.8.1).

children.label: Job
children.description: Unit of work performed outside the current execution context, with name, signature, details, and state history.

children.label: JobDetails
children.description: Type, method to execute, and arguments extracted from the lambda via ASM and serialized to JSON.

children.label: Job name
children.description: Human-readable name: (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Parameter value, JobBuilder value, or derived default.

children.label: Job history
children.description: Ordered record of all states the job has passed through.

children.label: ENQUEUED state
children.description: Job waiting to be claimed by a server ((root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Feedback).

children.label: SCHEDULED state
children.description: Job waiting for its due moment ((root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Feedback with instant + reason).

children.label: PROCESSING state
children.description: Job currently claimed and executed by a server ((root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Feedback with server identity).

children.label: SUCCEEDED state
children.description: Job completed, with latency and process durations recorded ((root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Feedback).

children.label: FAILED state
children.description: Job exhausted all retries; stays visible in the dashboard, never silently dropped.

children.label: Orphaned-job detection
children.description: Server updates a processing job every poll interval (default 15 s); stale PROCESSING jobs are reclaimed after crash.

children.label: RecurringJob
children.description: A (root) > Technical Element Set > Production Technical System > Production Technical Object > Constitutive Technical Object template with a cron expression or fixed interval attached; the master node schedules due instances each poll cycle.

children.label: Cron expression
children.description: Schedule definition (plain cron; advanced CRON is Pro).

children.label: OSS recurring limit
children.description: Up to 100 recurring jobs in OSS (5000 in Pro) — exemplar quota.

children.label: enqueue
children.description: Fire-and-forget: BackgroundJob.enqueue(() -> service.work(arg)) runs once, almost immediately.

children.label: schedule
children.description: Delayed: BackgroundJob.schedule(Instant.now().plus(5, DAYS), () -> …) runs once at a due moment, surviving restarts.

children.label: scheduleRecurrently
children.description: Recurring: scheduleRecurrently("daily-report", Cron.daily(), () -> …) runs on a fixed schedule.

children.label: JobScheduler
children.description: Injectable scheduler behind the static facade; preferable for testability.

children.label: Idempotent creation
children.description: Creating a job with an already-existing id does not save it again.

children.label: Spring Boot starter
children.description: Auto-configured scheduler, server, activator, and (root) > Technical Element Set > Production Technical System > Production Technical Object > Constitutive Technical Object support for Spring Boot.

children.label: Fluent API
children.description: Plain-Java (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Interface setup without a framework.

children.label: StorageProvider
children.description: Abstraction persisting all job information as JSON; no job data kept in process memory.

children.label: RDBMS shape
children.description: Four tables and a view in relational backends.

children.label: Dashboard
children.description: Built-in real-time web UI for monitoring jobs, servers, and failures.

children.label: JobRunrDashboardWebServer
children.description: Embedded server exposing the UI at http://localhost:8000 by default (exemplar).

children.label: State inspection
children.description: Per-job view: history, arguments, stack traces on failure.

children.label: Manual requeue/delete
children.description: One-click operator intervention on listed jobs.

children.label: Pro search and auth (Pro)
children.description: Advanced search, authentication, SSO, custom context path, framework-embedded serving.

children.label: continueWith (Pro)
children.description: Job chaining: continuation runs once the enclosing job or batch finishes.

children.label: Batches (Pro)
children.description: Parent job aggregating child jobs with a single continuation.

children.label: External jobs (Pro)
children.description: Tracking work finishing outside the JVM (GPU inference, human approval), signalled done from anywhere.

children.label: Server tags (Pro)
children.description: Routing jobs to tagged servers (e.g. GPU nodes).

children.label: Rate limiters (Pro)
children.description: Bounded execution rate against downstream systems.

children.label: Job result (Pro)
children.description: Return-value capture and retrieval for completed jobs.

children.label: Replacing jobs (Pro)
children.description: Superseding a pending job with a newer definition.

children.label: Transaction plugin (Pro)
children.description: Enqueueing jobs atomically inside the application's transaction.

children.label: Instant processing (Pro)
children.description: Bypassing poll latency for immediate execution.

children.label: Database migrations (Pro)
children.description: Schema migration support for the job store.

children.label: Minimal dependencies
children.description: ASM (lambda inspection), slf4j, plus one JSON library.

children.label: BackgroundJob facade
children.description: Static helpers ((root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Interface, schedule, scheduleRecurrently) delegating to the JobScheduler.

children.label: JobContext
children.description: Execution context handed to job methods for progress, logging, and durable steps.

children.label: runStepOnce
children.description: Idempotent durable step, e.g. runStepOnce("order-confirmation", () -> …); re-runs skip finished steps.

children.label: JobActivator
children.description: IoC bridge resolving job-method instances from Spring, Micronaut, Quarkus, or other containers.

children.label: JobFilter hooks
children.description: Extension points at every lifecycle stage for auditing, notifications, and custom logic.

children.label: %0 substitution
children.description: Positional argument interpolation in job names, e.g. "Send welcome email to %0".

children.label: @Recurring annotation
children.description: Declarative recurring-job registration on startup (Spring, Micronaut, Quarkus).

children.label: JobBuilder
children.description: Fluent builder for computed names and retry counts around a lambda or JobRequest.

children.label: RetryFilter
children.description: Built-in rescheduling with exponential back-off: 10 attempts by default.

children.label: RetryPolicy (Pro)
children.description: Declarative retry policies in the Pro tier.

children.label: BackgroundJobServer
children.description: In-process server polling storage, atomically claiming jobs, and invoking target methods.

children.label: Disabled by default
children.description: Server and dashboard must be explicitly enabled.

children.description: Never start more than one (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Constraint in the same JVM instance.

children.label: Worker pool

children.label: Atomic claim

children.label: Master election
children.description: Longest-running server becomes master and runs housekeeping: enqueueing scheduled jobs, scheduling recurring jobs, deleting jobs.

children.label: Horizontal scale-out
children.description: More application instances each join the cluster and share load automatically.

children.label: Carbon-aware processing
children.description: Scheduling strategy biased toward low-carbon grid windows.

children.label: Microservice deployment

children.label: REST-offload practice
children.description: Repeatable pattern: return the HTTP response immediately, run the long work as an enqueued job.

children.label: Newsletter practice
children.description: Repeatable pattern: mass notifications as fire-and-forget jobs.

children.label: Batch-import practice
children.description: Repeatable pattern: XML/CSV/JSON imports as background batches.

children.label: Recurring-report practice
children.description: Repeatable pattern: automated reports as recurring jobs.

children.label: Command-handler practice
children.description: Repeatable pattern: (root) > Technical Element Set > Technical Practice/JobRequestHandler separation of job data and logic.

children.label: Transformer System
children.description: Vendor-neutral sequence-processing system: architecture, trained model, training and serving apparatus.

children.label: Technical Architecture
children.description: Grouping: the structural organization the system is built from.

children.label: Attention-Based Sequence Architecture
children.description: Uniform repeated blocks of multi-head self-attention plus position-wise feed-forward; no recurrence; order injected.

children.label: Uniform Block Repetition
children.description: One block shape repeated N times, making depth a parameter rather than a design variable.

children.label: Permutation Equivariance
children.description: Without a positional signal the block commutes with input order; the design's claim is relational, not sequential.

children.label: Parallelism Over Positions
children.description: Every position is computed simultaneously during training; the serial dependency of recurrence disappears.

children.label: Residual Stream With Normalization
children.description: Every sublayer reads and adds to one shared width-d_model channel, keeping gradient paths short in depth.

children.label: Technical Configuration
children.description: Grouping: configuration choices that define an architecture variant.

children.label: Layer-Norm Placement
children.description: Normalize before each sublayer (pre-LN) or after the residual addition (post-LN).

children.label: Positional Signal Scheme
children.description: Sinusoidal, learnt absolute, rotary, or additive-bias encoding of position.

children.label: Head Split
children.description: Number of heads h and per-head width d_k = d_model / h.

children.label: Decoder Masking Policy
children.description: Causal mask, fully bidirectional attention, or hybrid prefix masking.

children.label: Attention Read Pattern
children.description: Self-attention, cross-attention, or multi-query and grouped-query key sharing.

children.label: Bidirectional Versus Causal Context
children.description: Reading both sides of a token buys representation, but forbids autoregressive generation.

children.label: Exact Versus Approximate Attention
children.description: Dense attention preserves retrieval fidelity at quadratic cost; sparsity buys context at accuracy risk.

children.label: Training Parallelism Versus Inference Memory
children.description: Parallel training admits long sequences; KV-cache growth makes long-context inference memory-bound.

children.label: Production Technical Object
children.description: Grouping: production objects realizing the system.

children.label: Transformer Model
children.description: Vendor-neutral trained model object; checkpoints and deployments realize it.

children.label: Encoder Stack
children.description: N stacked bidirectional blocks producing contextual representations.

children.label: Multi-Head Self-Attention Sublayer
children.description: h parallel attention heads over the same sequence, concatenated and projected.

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: parameters of the scoring function.

children.label: Scaling Factor √d_k
children.description: Keeps score variance near one so the softmax does not saturate.

children.label: Technical Interface
children.description: Grouping: interfaces of the attention sublayer.

children.label: Query-Key-Value Boundary
children.description: The three learnt projections through which a position proposes, advertises, and offers content.

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: parameters of the attention sublayer.

children.label: Head Count h = 8
children.description: Eight heads of width 64 (exemplar, base configuration).

children.label: Position-Wise Feed-Forward Sublayer
children.description: Two linear maps with a nonlinearity, applied identically at every position.

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: parameters of the feed-forward sublayer.

children.label: Inner Width d_ff = 2048
children.description: Four times the model width (exemplar, base configuration).

children.label: Decoder Stack
children.description: N stacked causal blocks with cross-attention onto the encoder output.

children.label: Token Embedding
children.description: Lookup from vocabulary ids into width-d_model vectors, scaled by √d_model.

children.label: Positional Encoding
children.description: Sinusoidal signal added to embeddings so that order becomes addressable.

children.label: Output Head
children.description: Linear map to vocabulary logits, normalized into a next-token distribution.

children.label: Model Width d_model = 512
children.description: Residual-stream and embedding width (exemplar, base configuration).

children.label: Stack Depth N = 6
children.description: Number of identical blocks in each stack (exemplar, base configuration).

children.label: Per-Head Width d_k = d_v = 64
children.description: Width of each head's key and value projection (exemplar, base configuration).

children.label: Dropout Rate 0.1
children.description: Regularization applied to sublayer outputs and embeddings (exemplar value).

children.label: Context Length
children.description: Maximum number of positions the positional scheme and attention span admit (exemplar per model).

children.label: Parameter Count
children.description: Total trainable tensors across embeddings, blocks, and output projection (exemplar per model).

children.label: Training Compute 6ND
children.description: Forward and backward FLOPs for N parameters over D training tokens (exemplar per run).

children.label: Technical Constraint
children.description: Grouping: bounds the model operates under.

children.label: Quadratic Attention Cost
children.description: O(n²·d) time and memory in sequence length for dense attention.

children.label: Fixed Context Window
children.description: Attention spans a bounded position range fixed at training time.

children.label: No Native Recurrent State
children.description: No hidden state carried between calls; a key–value cache substitutes for it.

children.label: Sequence Transduction
children.description: Maps an input sequence to an output sequence across vocabularies and modalities.

children.label: In-Context Retrieval
children.description: Pulls facts placed in the prompt without weight updates.

children.label: Transfer From Pretraining
children.description: Reaches downstream tasks by adaptation rather than training from scratch.

children.label: Parallel Training
children.description: Trains on all positions of a sequence at once rather than step by step.

children.label: Technical Blueprint
children.description: Grouping: generative descriptions of the system.

children.label: Attention Is All You Need (2017)
children.description: Paper specifying block structure, hyperparameters, and training recipe.

children.label: Base Configuration Table
children.description: Table 3 of the paper: N=6, d_model=512, h=8, d_ff=2048, dropout 0.1.

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: measured training settings of the base run.

children.label: Training Steps 100,000
children.description: Scheduling horizon for the base run (exemplar).

children.label: Adam β2 0.98
children.description: Second-moment decay chosen for stability at high learning rate (exemplar).

children.label: Production Technical Object
children.description: Grouping: production objects shipped with the paper.

children.label: Technical Task

children.label: Pretraining
children.description: Objective-driven training over a large corpus; produces the base model.

children.label: General Technique
children.description: Grouping: generalized methods used for the task.

children.label: Next-Token Prediction
children.description: Causal modelling: predict position t+1 from its prefix.

children.description: Optimizer and schedule that keep large-batch training stable.

children.description: Grouping: acts performed under the optimizer technique.

children.label: Forward Pass
children.description: Computes logits and loss for one batch.

children.label: Backward Pass
children.description: Reverse-mode differentiation through the block stack.

children.label: Optimizer Step
children.description: Updates weights, advances the schedule, and increments the step counter.

children.label: Mixed-Precision Training
children.description: Low-precision compute with high-precision master weights.

children.label: Gradient Accumulation
children.description: Emulates a large batch under a fixed memory budget.

children.label: Sequence Packing
children.description: Concatenates short sequences so the context is fully used.

children.label: Masked Token Prediction
children.description: Bidirectional modelling: reconstruct masked positions from context.

children.label: Span Corruption
children.description: Span corruption: reconstruct a target sequence from a corrupted source.

children.label: Fine-Tuning
children.description: Adapts base weights to instructions, preferences, or a target task.

children.label: Inference Serving
children.description: Autoregressive decoding with caching, batching, and sampling.

children.label: Constitutive Technique
children.description: Grouping: techniques embodied in the architecture itself.

children.label: Scaled Dot-Product Scoring
children.description: Similarity computation embodied in the attention mechanism.

children.label: Softmax Normalization
children.description: Convex weighting across positions embodied in the mechanism.

children.label: Residual Accumulation
children.description: Additive state update embodied in every block.

children.label: Realized capability
children.description: Capability realized: edit genomes, express proteins, culture cells, and scale fermentation to specification.

children.label: Genome-editing capability
children.description: Value realized: precise sequence changes in living genomes, realized by nuclease and delivery mechanisms.

children.label: Expression capability
children.description: Value realized: functional product from an engineered construct, realized by transcription-translation mechanisms.

children.label: Cell-culture capability
children.description: Value realized: viable expanding cell populations, realized by medium, gas, and sterility mechanisms.

children.label: Fermentation-scale capability
children.description: Value realized: manufacturing-scale output at constant quality, realized by transfer and control mechanisms.

children.label: Biotechnology Problem
children.description: The overall problematique of biotechnology: the gap between current living-substrate states and desired engineered states across therapeutics, agriculture, aquaculture, and industry, decomposed below into specific technical problems.

children.label: Expression Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired functional product yield at required purity and activity.

children.label: Titer target
children.description: Formalized yield objective per batch (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Viability floor
children.description: Minimum acceptable culture viability at harvest (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Expression Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding expression problem conformance.

children.label: Scale-up Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between bench productivity and manufacturing-scale productivity at constant quality.

children.label: Volumetric productivity target
children.description: Formalized grams per liter per day objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Oxygen transfer floor
children.description: Minimum kLa sustaining aerobic demand at scale (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Scale-up Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding scale-up problem conformance.

children.label: Stability Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired genetic and phenotypic stability over passages.

children.label: Passage stability target
children.description: Formalized passage window retaining productivity (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Mutation-rate ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable per-base per-generation drift (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Stability Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding stability problem conformance.

children.label: Purity Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired impurity clearance for host-cell protein, DNA, and aggregates.

children.label: HCP clearance target
children.description: Formalized log-reduction objective across the train (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Aggregate ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable aggregate fraction at release (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Purity Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding purity problem conformance.

children.label: Sterility Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired freedom from adventitious agents across open operations.

children.label: Sterility assurance target
children.description: Formalized SAL objective for aseptic operations (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Bioburden ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable pre-sterile bioburden (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Sterility Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding sterility problem conformance.

children.label: Glycosylation Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired human-like glycan profile for effector function and clearance.

children.label: Glycan profile target
children.description: Formalized glycoform distribution objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: High-mannose ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable high-mannose fraction (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Glycosylation Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding glycosylation problem conformance.

children.label: Immunogenicity Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired low anti-drug-antibody incidence for a biologic.

children.label: ADA incidence target
children.description: Formalized treatment-emergent ADA ceiling (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: T-cell epitope burden
children.description: Assessed epitope load driving deimmunization (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Immunogenicity Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding immunogenicity problem conformance.

children.label: Delivery Problem
children.description: Reliably delivering a biological, biochemical, genetic, cellular, or therapeutic payload to a specified biological target, location, or compartment while achieving the required dose, timing, specificity, and biological effect.

children.label: Delivered-dose requirement
children.description: Formalized delivered-dose objective at the target site (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Vector dose ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable vector genomes per kilogram (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Delivery Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding delivery problem conformance.

children.label: Cold-chain Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired stability across storage, transport, and thaw.

children.label: Shelf-life target
children.description: Formalized months-at-temperature stability objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Freeze-thaw ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable potency loss per cycle (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Cold-chain Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding cold-chain problem conformance.

children.label: Contamination Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired mycoplasma, viral, and cross-culture freedom.

children.label: Mycoplasma-free target
children.description: Formalized not-detected objective by NAT (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Adventitious-virus ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable adventitious signal pre-clearance (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Contamination Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding contamination problem conformance.

children.label: Data-integrity Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired ALCOA record completeness across batch and assay data.

children.label: Record completeness target
children.description: Formalized attributable complete record objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Audit-trail gap ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable unattributed record gap (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Data-integrity Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding data-integrity problem conformance.

children.label: Cost-of-goods Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired cost per gram or per dose at commercial scale.

children.label: Yield-variability ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable batch-to-batch titer CV (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Cost-of-goods Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding cost-of-goods problem conformance.

children.label: Trait-stability Problem assay specification

children.label: Practice
children.description: The overall organized patterns of technical work in biotechnology, decomposed below into specific technical practices.

children.label: Genetic Engineering Practice
children.description: Repeatable organized pattern of deliberately modifying genomes across kingdoms: constructing DNA, delivering it into cells, editing loci, and verifying the result.

children.label: Delivery Problem
children.description: The overall delivery problematique: getting the payload to its target, decomposed below into targeting, transport, stability, and dosage problems.

children.label: Targeting Problem
children.description: Getting the payload to the intended cells, tissue, organ, or organism; e.g. AAV capsid tropism for hepatocytes, or seed-coat inoculant placement on the spermosphere.

children.label: Target-coverage requirement
children.description: Formalized fraction of the intended target population reached (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: On-target fraction floor
children.description: Minimum reached fraction of intended cells or sites (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Transport Problem
children.description: Moving the payload through biological barriers; e.g. LNP extravasation to solid tumors, or foliar dsRNA crossing cuticle and cell wall.

children.label: Barrier-penetration requirement
children.description: Formalized crossing objective per barrier (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Barrier-crossing floor
children.description: Minimum transported fraction past the governing barrier (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: In-transit Stability Problem
children.description: Preventing degradation or loss of activity during delivery; e.g. mRNA integrity in circulation, or dsRNA persistence on the leaf surface under UV. Distinct from passage stability of cell lines.

children.label: In-transit integrity requirement
children.description: Formalized active-fraction objective at the target (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Active-fraction floor
children.description: Minimum intact active payload arriving at the target (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Dosage Problem
children.description: Delivering the required quantity or concentration; e.g. vector genomes per kilogram, or long-acting veterinary depot dose per head.

children.label: Dose-accuracy requirement
children.description: Formalized delivered-quantity objective within tolerance (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Dose-tolerance band
children.description: Accepted deviation around the labeled delivered dose (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Release Problem
children.description: Releasing the payload at the intended location and time; e.g. endosomal escape of LNP cargo, or pH-triggered release of seed-coat actives in soil.

children.label: Release-timing requirement
children.description: Formalized release location-and-time objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Release-window parameter
children.description: Accepted burst-versus-sustained release window (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Uptake Problem
children.description: Enabling the target cell or tissue to internalize the payload; e.g. receptor-mediated endocytosis of conjugates, or gill and gut uptake of bath and oral aquatic vaccines.

children.label: Uptake-efficiency floor
children.description: Minimum internalized fraction in target cells (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Localization Problem
children.description: Achieving the required intracellular or extracellular location; e.g. nuclear import of editors versus cytosolic retention of mRNA.

children.label: Nuclear-localization fraction
children.description: Measured nuclear fraction where nuclear action is required (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Specificity Problem
children.description: Minimizing delivery to unintended biological targets; e.g. detargeted AAV capsids, or pollinator-safe foliar timing. Distinct from edit specificity once delivered.

children.label: Off-target requirement
children.description: Formalized ceiling on unintended-target exposure (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Off-target exposure ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable payload in non-target tissues or organisms (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Persistence Problem
children.description: Maintaining the payload at the target for the required duration; e.g. durable transgene expression, or silage-inoculant survival through feedout.

children.label: Target half-life floor
children.description: Minimum effect half-life at the target site (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Delivery Efficiency Problem
children.description: Maximizing the fraction of administered payload that reaches and affects the intended target; the roll-up of targeting, transport, stability, release, and uptake.

children.label: Payload-yield requirement
children.description: Formalized administered-to-effective fraction objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Fraction-reaching-target floor
children.description: Minimum effective fraction of the administered dose (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Edit-specificity Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired on-target edit rate at tolerable off-target burden.

children.label: On-target rate target
children.description: Formalized edit efficiency objective per locus (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Off-target ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable off-target event burden (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Edit-specificity Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding edit-specificity problem conformance.

children.label: Transformation-recalcitrance Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired DNA-delivery and regeneration rates across crop genotypes.

children.label: Regenerable-genotype requirement
children.description: Formalized genotype coverage for the transformation pipeline (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Transformation-efficiency floor
children.description: Minimum independent transgenics per hundred explants (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Transformation-recalcitrance Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding transformation-recalcitrance problem conformance.

children.label: Transgene-silencing Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired stable transgene expression across generations.

children.label: Single-copy requirement
children.description: Formalized single-locus integration objective for commercial events.

children.label: Methylation-silencing ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable expression loss per generation (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Transgene-silencing Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding transgene-silencing problem conformance.

children.label: Genotype-dependence Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired protocol transfer from model cultivars to elite germplasm.

children.label: Elite-transfer requirement
children.description: Formalized elite-line coverage objective (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Cultivar-coverage parameter
children.description: Count of elite cultivars with working protocols (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Genotype-dependence Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding genotype-dependence problem conformance.

children.label: Assembly-failure Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired first-pass correct assemblies across fragment counts.

children.label: Overlap-design requirement
children.description: Formalized overlap length and GC rules per assembly (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Colony-screen burden
children.description: Maximum colonies screened per correct clone (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Assembly-failure Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding assembly-failure problem conformance.

children.label: Assembly-mutation Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired error-free inserts after PCR-based assembly.

children.label: Polymerase-fidelity requirement
children.description: Formalized acceptable error rate per kilobase (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Mutation-per-clone ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable coding mutations per verified clone (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Assembly-mutation Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding assembly-mutation problem conformance.

children.label: Host-toxicity Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired propagation of toxic ORFs in cloning hosts.

children.label: Toxicity-mitigation requirement
children.description: Formalized tight-repression or low-copy strategy for toxic inserts (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Leakiness ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable basal expression during propagation (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Host-toxicity Problem assay specification
children.description: Precise acceptance conditions deciding host-toxicity problem conformance.

children.label: Plasmid-instability Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired maintenance of repeat-bearing plasmids over generations.

children.label: Repeat-tolerance requirement
children.description: Formalized repeat-length limit per host background (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Rearrangement ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable rearranged fraction in stock (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Energy Technology
children.description: Useful-energy ensemble: domain, carrier fleets, grid, stores, practices, markets, and agents operated across carriers.

children.label: Membership criterion
children.description: Rule distinguishing members from non-members: all elements required to move energy from primary carrier to useful end use.

children.label: Carrier-membership condition
children.description: Member handles a primary carrier within scope: sun, wind, water, atom, or hydrocarbon.

children.label: Stage-membership condition
children.description: Member sits on the chain: conversion, delivery, storage, or end use.

children.label: Energy Technical Domain
children.description: Bounded field: converting, delivering, storing, and using energy under intermittency, loss, and adequacy bounds.

children.label: Realized capability
children.description: Capability realized: useful energy on demand across carriers and distances.

children.label: Conversion capability
children.description: Value realized: primary carriers turned into electricity, heat, or fuel.

children.label: Delivery capability
children.description: Value realized: energy moved from source to load within limits.

children.label: Storage capability
children.description: Value realized: energy held across hours to seasons for later use.

children.label: Energy Problem
children.description: The overall problematique: the gap between variable supply and firm useful demand at acceptable cost and emissions.

children.label: Intermittency Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between variable renewable output and firm demand across hours and seasons.

children.label: Variable-share ceiling
children.description: Maximum instantaneous variable share operable without curtailment (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Dispatchable-capacity requirement
children.description: Formalized firm capacity objective covering Dunkelflaute-type events (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Congestion Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between desired transfers and available network capacity at congested corridors.

children.label: Transfer-capacity requirement
children.description: Formalized cross-zonal capacity objective per corridor (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Congestion-rent parameter
children.description: Measured price spread across a congested boundary (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Conversion-loss Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between primary energy in and useful energy out across conversion steps.

children.label: Loss-budget requirement
children.description: Formalized chain-efficiency objective from carrier to end use (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Round-trip-efficiency floor
children.description: Minimum acceptable storage cycle efficiency (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Emissions Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between current and desired greenhouse-gas intensity of delivered energy.

children.label: Abatement requirement
children.description: Formalized emissions-reduction objective per planning horizon (exemplar per deployment).

children.label: Carbon-intensity ceiling
children.description: Maximum tolerable grams of CO2 per delivered kilowatt-hour (exemplar value per deployment).

children.label: Adequacy Problem
children.description: Discrepancy between installed firm capacity and peak demand plus reserves.

children.label: Reserve-margin requirement

children.label: Attention
children.description: Content-addressed weighted read: every query is scored against every retained key and answered with a convex mixture of the values.

children.label: Every Retained Position Contributes
children.description: No exclusion by default: each key receives a weight. Masking is the only exclusion, and it constrains the read rather than performing it.

children.label: Content-Addressed Scoring
children.description: The score depends on the query–key pair, not on position or address.

children.label: Differentiable Aggregation
children.description: The output is a smooth function of the parameters, so both the metric and the value space are fitted end to end.

children.label: Order Independence Without Position
children.description: Pairwise scoring commutes with input order; sequence order must be injected elsewhere.

children.label: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
children.description: The reference realization: similarity, scaling, softmax, weighted read.

children.label: Similarity Scoring
children.description: — pairwise compatibility between every query and key.

children.label: Score Scaling
children.description: Divide the scores by so their variance stays near one as head width grows.

children.label: Softmax Normalization
children.description: Map scores to non-negative weights summing to one over the retained keys.

children.label: Weighted Aggregation
children.description: Return — always a mixture of values, never the selection of one.

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: parameters of the scoring function.

children.label: Scale $\sqrt{d_k}$
children.description: Variance-control factor fixed by the head width.

children.label: Query-Key-Value Boundary
children.description: The three learned projections through which a position proposes, advertises, and offers content.

children.label: Technical Constraint
children.description: Grouping: bounds the mechanism operates under.

children.label: Causal Mask
children.description: Upper-triangular exclusion of future keys, so position reads only its prefix.

children.label: Quadratic Cost in Sequence Length
children.description: time and memory for dense pairwise scoring.

children.label: Exact Versus Approximate Scoring
children.description: Dense scoring preserves retrieval fidelity at quadratic cost; sparse and linear variants buy asymptotics at fidelity risk.

children.label: Additive Attention
children.description: A small network scores each pair (Bahdanau).

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: parameters of the alignment network.

children.label: Multi-Head Attention
children.description: parallel reads of the same sequence, concatenated and projected.

children.label: Technical Parameter
children.description: Grouping: parameters of the head split.

children.label: Per-Head Width $d_k = d_{model} / h$
children.description: Width of each head's query and key projection.

children.label: Head Concatenation and Output Projection
children.description: — rejoins the reads into one width- vector.

children.label: Technical Element Set
children.description: Grouping: the family reading of attention.

children.label: Attention Variant Set
children.description: The mechanisms that count as attention by lineage and function, not only by exact softmax form.

children.label: Technical Mechanism
children.description: Grouping: members of the set, typed as mechanisms.

children.label: Self-Attention
children.description: Queries, keys, and values drawn from one sequence.

children.label: Cross-Attention
children.description: Queries from one sequence, keys and values from another.

children.label: Multi-Query Attention
children.description: One shared key/value projection across all query heads.

children.label: Grouped-Query Attention
children.description: Query heads partitioned into groups that share a key/value projection.

children.label: Sparse Attention
children.description: Fixed or learned sparsity patterns reduce the set of scored pairs.

children.label: Linear Attention
children.description: Kernel feature maps replace the softmax so scoring runs in linear time.

children.label: Memory-Augmented Attention
children.description: Keys and values stored from earlier context and re-read later.

children.label: Axial Attention
children.description: Independent attention along each image or tensor axis.

children.label: Hierarchical Attention
children.description: Attention applied at successive levels, such as word, sentence, and paragraph.

children.label: Technical Practice
children.description: Grouping: practice embodied in the mechanism.

children.label: Scaled Dot-Product Scoring
children.description: Similarity computation embodied in the mechanism.

children.label: Softmax Normalization
children.description: Convex weighting across positions embodied in the mechanism.

children.label: Convex Aggregation
children.description: Returning a mixture rather than a choice, embodied in the mechanism.

children.label: Attention-Mass Check
children.description: Every query's weights are non-negative and sum to one over the retained keys.

children.label: Shape and Mask Parity
children.description: Head widths, mask shape, and numerical parity against the reference implementation.

children.label: Alignment Quality
children.description: Whether the weights align the positions they purport to relate, in translation and retrieval.

children.label: Downstream Task Metric
children.description: Whether the read improves the task the block serves.
